requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles supporting 6K Black and 6K CMY page yield, with CMY bottle size >8K.
requirements.Rationale: To increase consumable capacity and meet high-volume printing needs, supporting longer intervals between replacements.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility with NOA-F, SuperAmp PHA, and existing ink systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NGB keyed bottles deliver 6,000 pages for Black, 6,000 pages for CMY (with CMY bottle size >8,000 pages), verified by yield tests.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure the bottle design and ink delivery system provide spill-free operation during installation and use.
requirements.Rationale: To improve user experience and reduce maintenance/service calls due to ink spills.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: User installs bottle with no ink spillage in 100% of test cases under defined use scenarios.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate NOA-F with a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, maintaining compatibility with click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: To improve reliability and security of ink delivery and maintain compatibility with existing mechanisms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F units pass reliability tests and are compatible with click-on push-push and TDF in all production units.

requirements.Title: Reuse SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Ink
requirements.Description: Reuse SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie pigment inks without ink reformulation.
requirements.Rationale: To leverage proven technology, reduce development time, and maintain ink quality.
requirements.Dependencies: Existing SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie ink specifications.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie inks are used in production units with no reformulation required.

requirements.Title: Reliability and Ink Stability Modeling
requirements.Description: Model and characterize reliability, WVTR, air gain, flow rate, IDS, startup, and NOA-F EOL for the ink system, including ink stability in tank and impact to print quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: To ensure robust and consistent printer performance throughout its lifecycle.
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with IDS and NOA-F systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Comprehensive models and test results demonstrating system reliability and ink stability over defined lifecycle.

requirements.Title: NOA-F as Service Parts in Warranty Support
requirements.Description: Provide NOA-F as service parts for warranty support, ensuring availability during warranty period.
requirements.Rationale: To support post-sale serviceability and customer satisfaction.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F available as service part for all units under warranty within defined SLA.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 feature on the lid of the ink system.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance product intelligence, traceability, or anti-counterfeiting measures.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All lids incorporate Acumen 6 and are validated for intended function.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F and Magi Ink Cart
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA14 line for NOA-F, add Magi ink cart and labeling tool in Orcus 5, and ensure PHA + Dry FI + USG + push-push assembly in printer factory.
requirements.Rationale: To support new components and maintain production efficiency.
requirements.Dependencies: Existing SA14 and Orcus 5 line configurations.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Production lines modified and validated to support new components without impacting throughput.

requirements.Title: Mold for 1 to 4 New Keyed Caps
requirements.Description: Develop molds for 1 to 4 new keyed caps for bottles.
requirements.Rationale: To support new bottle keying and prevent cross-contamination or misinstallation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Molds created and caps produced pass fit and function tests.

requirements.Title: Support Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Enable end users to replace PHA and NOA-F components without technical assistance.
requirements.Rationale: To improve serviceability and reduce downtime for customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Design of PHA and NOA-F for user replacement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Users can replace PHA and NOA-F following provided instructions in >95% of usability tests.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80K Pages
requirements.Description: Design printer and consumables to support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To increase product longevity and competitiveness in the market.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer and consumables meet or exceed 80,000 page life in accelerated lifecycle testing.

requirements.Title: SKU 2 (Hi + Hi PDL) PaaS
requirements.Description: Develop SKU 2 supporting both Hi and Hi PDL, with Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) support.
requirements.Rationale: To address diverse market segments and enable flexible business models.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SKU 2 available for order with Hi and Hi PDL options, and PaaS functionality enabled.

requirements.Title: Reddington ID with Increased Tank Size
requirements.Description: Implement Reddington ID with increased tank size, ensuring no change to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: To accommodate higher ink volumes and maintain compatibility with existing document feeders.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Reddington ID supports increased tank size and is validated for ADF compatibility.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam packaging for the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure product protection during shipping and handling.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: EPS foam packaging passes drop and vibration tests per HP standards.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3 and LOT4 Environmental Requirements, Blue Angel for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure compliance with EPEAT3, LOT4 environmental requirements, and Blue Angel certification for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: To meet regulatory and sustainability standards, and enhance marketability.
requirements.Dependencies: Design and material selection, certification processes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product achieves EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel certifications as applicable.

requirements.Title: Input and Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to align with increased tank protrusion and optimize size.
requirements.Rationale: To accommodate new tank size and maintain print media handling reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays are compatible with tank protrusion and pass paper handling reliability tests.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (Color Graphic Display) in the printer UI.
requirements.Rationale: To provide improved user interface and experience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4.3” CGD display is functional and passes user acceptance tests.

requirements.Title: Leverage Sayan Sibstar Tubes with New Routing and Integration
requirements.Description: Use Sayan Sibstar tubes with new tube routing and integration for ink delivery.
requirements.Rationale: To optimize ink delivery and support new tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tube routing supports required flow rates and passes reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management with Spit Platform Changes
requirements.Description: Implement service station aerosol management with necessary changes to the spit platform due to tank design.
requirements.Rationale: To maintain print quality and prevent aerosol contamination.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol levels are within HP defined limits in all tested scenarios.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model with Tube and New Weights
requirements.Description: Develop a dynamic and force model for the carriage, accounting for new tube routing and weight changes.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure mechanical reliability and print quality with new design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Model validated and carriage performance meets HP standards in all test cases.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Support for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Modify paper path components to support increased page life of 80K pages.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure durability and reliability over extended use.
requirements.Dependencies: Paper path and overall printer design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path components meet 80K page durability in accelerated testing.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Serviceable Part (Post 80K Life)
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance as a serviceable part, replaceable at service center after 80K page life.
requirements.Rationale: To support ongoing maintenance and extend product life.
requirements.Dependencies: Maintenance part design and service procedures.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Part is replaceable at service centers and validated in field trials.

requirements.Title: 140ml K Bottles and New CMY Bottle Sizes
requirements.Description: Introduce 140ml K (Black) bottles and new, larger capacity CMY bottles.
requirements.Rationale: To support higher print volumes and reduce frequency of consumable replacement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bottles meet specified volume and pass yield and reliability testing.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection for IDS
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and fluidic interconnect (FI) connection for IDS, leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI (SHAID).
requirements.Rationale: To improve ink delivery security, capacity, and system intelligence.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Connections meet flow, reliability, and security requirements in all test cases.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop new IDS startup algorithm and air management system for improved reliability and startup performance.
requirements.Rationale: To optimize printer startup and prevent air-related failures.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS and air management system design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup algorithm and air management validated in cold and warm start scenarios with zero failures.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality (PQ) Goals and Depletion Metrics
requirements.Description: Set new print quality goals and depletion metrics to align with page yield definitions.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure consistent output and accurate yield reporting.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Print quality and depletion metrics meet or exceed defined targets in all yield tests.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Leverage existing Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU hardware in the new design.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce development costs and leverage proven components.
requirements.Dependencies: Component compatibility with new system design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All reused components pass integration and functional testing in the new platform.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module and FW Dune
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module and FW Dune firmware in the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: To provide wireless connectivity and leverage existing firmware platform.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wi-Fi and firmware operate as intended in all connectivity and functional tests.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx hardware and firmware security features in the printer.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure product and data security.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Security features validated against HP security standards and penetration testing.

requirements.Title: Business Model and Solution Support for Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise
requirements.Description: Support business models for Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise, including PaaS, WorkFromHome/Flexworker, onboarding paths, and solution compatibility (scan, SMB manageability, enterprise support).
requirements.Rationale: To address diverse market needs and enable flexible deployment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Business models and solutions are available and functional for all targeted segments.

requirements.Title: Client and Driver Support (HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD)
requirements.Description: Ensure compatibility with HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD clients and drivers, as well as EasyStart, USS, and UFD.
requirements.Rationale: To provide seamless installation and operation across platforms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed clients and drivers are compatible and pass installation and function tests.

requirements.Title: Schedule Adherence as Constrained Priority
requirements.Description: Adhere to defined schedule checkpoints for hardware, NOA-F, and bottle development, as outlined in project plan.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure timely delivery and market launch.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All checkpoints met within defined timeframes as per project plan.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K as Constrained Priority
requirements.Description: Ensure SuperAmp PHA life is at least 65,000 pages as a non-flexible constraint.
requirements.Rationale: To meet reliability and warranty requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA demonstrates life of 65,000 pages in accelerated testing.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 2 Years and 80K Pages
requirements.Description: Optimize warranty life to 2 years or 80,000 pages, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: To align with industry standards and customer expectations.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty is valid for 2 years or 80K pages, and all components meet reliability requirements.

requirements.Title: Throughput of 25/20 PPM (PDL: 25/19PPM)
requirements.Description: Optimize printer throughput to achieve 25/20 pages per minute (PPM), with PDL at 25/19 PPM.
requirements.Rationale: To meet market performance expectations and remain competitive.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves specified throughput in standard performance tests.

requirements.Title: Serviceability - Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Optimize serviceability by providing a maintenance box for easy replacement and maintenance.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce downtime and improve user/service experience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box is user/service replaceable and passes field serviceability tests.

requirements.Title: SMB Solution Support
requirements.Description: Optimize printer features and solutions to support SMB requirements (manageability, cost, reliability).
requirements.Rationale: To target and win SMB market segment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer meets SMB manageability and cost requirements as defined by SMB feedback.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK and Trade Page 6K as Flexible Priorities
requirements.Description: Allow flexibility in supporting Host 12K-CMYK and Trade Page 6K requirements based on market and business needs.
requirements.Rationale: To provide adaptability in product offering and market response.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Host 12K-CMYK and Trade Page 6K features can be enabled/disabled as needed for specific SKUs.
